d1-airport.title: Private ride with Jerry to SFO
d1-airport.note: Pickup at 6:35 PM for four travelers and four large suitcases. The $50 fare has been paid through Venmo.

d1-checkin.title: Airport check-in and luggage drop
d1-checkin.note: Check passports, baggage allowance, airline desk and gate before boarding.

d1-pp-lounge.title: Priority Pass lounges at SFO (optional)
d1-pp-lounge.note: The Club SFO is in Terminal 1 near Gate B4, while LH459 departs International Terminal G. Allow plenty of walking time. Check guest privileges for all four.

d1-flight.title: Lufthansa LH459 nonstop to Munich
d1-flight.note: Departs SFO at 9:40 PM; scheduled arrival in Munich is 5:55 PM the following day.

d1-overnight.title: Overnight flight
d1-overnight.note: Sleep and get ready for the cold Munich evening.

d2-arrive.title: Arrive at Munich Airport (MUC)
d2-arrive.note: Scheduled arrival is 5:55 PM local time.

d2-ticket.title: Find airport S-Bahn and buy tickets
d2-ticket.note: Follow S-Bahn signs; check valid group airport-city tickets and fares before purchase.

d2-s8.title: S8 train to Rosenheimer Platz
d2-s8.note: Take S8 from Munich Airport toward the city, about 33 minutes to Rosenheimer Platz (subject to service). Follow signs for Gasteig / Muffatwerk and Holiday Inn to reach the indoor Motorama passage.

d2-hotel.title: Check in at Holiday Inn Munich
d2-hotel.note: At Rosenheimer Platz, follow signs for Gasteig / Muffatwerk rather than the Rosenheimer Platz street exit. Turn left in the station hall, pass the glass doors to Motorama and turn right. Stay on the same level past ALDI and HIT, then follow Holiday Inn signs up to reception. If the passage is closed, use the street entrance at Hochstraße 3.

d2-dinner.title: Dinner and rest
d2-dinner.note: Eat somewhere nearby and rest after the overnight flight.

d3-frauen.title: Frauenkirche Cathedral
d3-frauen.note: See Munich's famous twin towers and explore the cathedral if it is open.

d3-stpeter.title: Meet near St. Peter's Church
d3-stpeter.note: Walk to the meeting point before 10:30 AM and look for the yellow umbrella.

d3-tour.title: Walkative! Old Town guided tour
d3-tour.note: An English-language walking tour is confirmed. Be at the meeting point early.

d3-lunch.title: Lunch at Viktualienmarkt
d3-lunch.note: Try Bavarian foods at the traditional outdoor food market.

d3-kustermann.title: Kustermann: WÜSTHOF and RIEDEL shopping
d3-kustermann.note: Optional shopping for German kitchen knives, glassware and cookware.

d3-residenz.title: Munich Residenz Palace
d3-residenz.note: Explore historic palace rooms. Admission has not been purchased yet.

d3-max.title: Walk along Maximilianstraße
d3-max.note: Enjoy historic buildings and shops before returning to Marienplatz.

d3-music.title: Possible Christmas music at Marienplatz
d3-music.note: A musical performance around 5:30 PM is not yet confirmed; visit the market if there is no performance.

d3-market.title: Marienplatz Christmas market and dinner
d3-market.note: Browse Christmas stalls, food and warm drinks.

d4-breakfast.title: Breakfast and early transfer to castle tour meeting point
d4-breakfast.note: Allow time from Holiday Inn Munich City Centre to Sonnenstraße 1 (bus stop outside Fielmann). Mentor Reisen's winter update requests check-in around 8:40 AM; the coach leaves by 8:50 AM at the latest. Do not follow the old 9:15 AM departure.

d4-tour.title: Mentor Reisen: Two Castles tour (EARLIER departure)
d4-tour.note: Nov 18 update from Susanne, Team Mentor Reisen: winter castle guided tours start earlier. Please arrive at Sonnenstraße 1, 80331 Munich, at about 8:40 AM to check in. Everyone MUST depart by 8:50 AM at the latest—not 9:15 AM. The operator asks guests to acknowledge receipt. Confirm castle admission and payment separately.

d4-hohen.title: Hohenschwangau Castle
d4-hohen.note: Castle entrance tickets were held by the operator; confirm payment and admission time.

d4-neusch.title: Neuschwanstein Castle
d4-neusch.note: Ask the operator for the confirmed entry time and take care on icy slopes.

d4-alpsee.title: Lake Alpsee scenery
d4-alpsee.note: Optional lakeside photo stop, depending on your tour and the weather.

d4-bridge.title: Marienbrücke viewpoint
d4-bridge.note: Optional bridge view; it may close in winter due to ice or snow.

d4-return.title: Return to Munich and prepare for tomorrow
d4-return.note: The Nov 18 operator message does not give a revised return time. The old 7:15 PM estimate was based on 9:15 AM departure; do not treat it as confirmed. Pack luggage and EC353 train QR tickets for the 5:40 AM pickup tomorrow.

d5-checkout.title: Early checkout at Holiday Inn
d5-checkout.note: Pack breakfast, luggage and QR tickets for the 5:40 AM van.

d5-black.title: Blacklane Business Van to Munich Central Station
d5-black.note: Confirmed 5:40 AM pickup at Holiday Inn. Arrival time is estimated, not guaranteed.

d5-platform.title: Find EC353 platform at München Hbf
d5-platform.note: Check departure screens and find coach 259 in time.

d5-train.title: EC353 train from Munich to Prague
d5-train.note: Four tickets bought: second class, coach 259, seats 54, 56, 65, 67. 6:44 AM to 12:21 PM.

d5-prague.title: Arrive at Prague Main Station
d5-prague.note: Scheduled arrival at Praha hlavní nádraží: 12:21 PM.

d5-grand.title: Bag drop at The Grand Mark
d5-grand.note: Leave luggage at the hotel; standard check-in begins at 3 PM.

d5-oldtown.title: Old Town Square and Astronomical Clock
d5-oldtown.note: Enjoy your first look at Prague's historic center.

d5-bridge.title: Charles Bridge at sunset
d5-bridge.note: Take photos of Charles Bridge and the Vltava river at dusk.

d5-miru.title: Náměstí Míru Christmas market
d5-miru.note: Browse Christmas stalls in Peace Square and enjoy warm treats.

d5-evening.title: Dinner and back to The Grand Mark
d5-evening.note: Relax before a full sightseeing day.

d6-transit.title: Travel to Prague Castle
d6-transit.note: Take Prague transit toward the castle and allow time for walking uphill.

d6-castle.title: Prague Castle highlights
d6-castle.note: Visit courtyards, St. Vitus Cathedral and other historic sites. Admission must be confirmed.

d6-starbucks.title: Coffee break at Prague Castle
d6-starbucks.note: Warm up with a drink and enjoy the view.

d6-porks.title: Malá Strana and pork-knuckle lunch
d6-porks.note: Explore Lesser Town and consider lunch at Pork's. No reservation has been made.

d6-river.title: Vltava river and Charles Bridge photos
d6-river.note: Take a short riverside photo stop, weather permitting.

d6-ujezd.title: Walk to Újezd funicular stop
d6-ujezd.note: Reach the lower funicular stop and check whether it is operating.

d6-up.title: Petřín funicular uphill
d6-up.note: Planned ride only if service is operating; confirm tickets and any closure.

d6-petrin.title: Petřín Hill lookout
d6-petrin.note: Enjoy views of Prague; the observation tower is optional and ticketed.

d6-down.title: Petřín funicular downhill
d6-down.note: Return toward Újezd if service is running.

d6-rest.title: Return to The Grand Mark for a break
d6-rest.note: Rest before the potential evening concert.

d6-dinner.title: Dinner near Municipal House
d6-dinner.note: Have dinner early if you plan to attend the concert.

d6-entry.title: Go to Smetana Hall
d6-entry.note: The concert is not booked. Buy tickets and confirm entry rules first.

d6-concert.title: Classical music at Smetana Hall (not booked)
d6-concert.note: An 8 PM concert is under consideration; tickets have not been purchased.

d7-breakfast.title: Breakfast and pack luggage
d7-breakfast.note: Relaxed morning before exploring Old Town and changing hotels.

d7-checkout.title: Check out and leave bags at The Grand Mark
d7-checkout.note: Leave luggage at the front desk for collection later.

d7-square.title: Old Town Square, clock and Týn Church
d7-square.note: Explore the square, Astronomical Clock and church surroundings.

d7-lunch.title: Lunch in Old Town
d7-lunch.note: Choose a restaurant in the historic center.

d7-josefov.title: Walk through the Jewish Quarter
d7-josefov.note: See the historic neighborhood. Indoor admissions need separate tickets.

d7-celetna.title: Browse shops along Celetná Street
d7-celetna.note: Visit local craft, glass and souvenir shops.

d7-manuf.title: MANUFAKTURA souvenir shopping
d7-manuf.note: Find Czech soaps, skincare and gifts.

d7-powder.title: Powder Tower and Municipal House
d7-powder.note: Explore the architectural highlights near Republic Square.

d7-republiky.title: Republic Square Christmas market
d7-republiky.note: Visit the market scheduled to open November 25.

d7-move.title: Collect luggage and move to Hotel Royal
d7-move.note: Take Metro B toward Křižíkova and walk to Hotel Royal.

d7-dinner.title: Dinner in Karlín
d7-dinner.note: Dinner near Hotel Royal and rest for tomorrow's early CK trip.

d8-breakfast.title: Meet friends at Hotel Royal and head to bus station
d8-breakfast.note: Plan to leave together around 6:15–6:40 AM for Anděl / Na Knížecí. Final timing depends on booked tickets.

d8-busout.title: Coach to Český Krumlov with friends (unbooked)
d8-busout.note: Target departure around 7 AM; allow roughly 2.5–3.25 hours. The bus, price and stops are not confirmed.

d8-walk.title: Arrive in CK and walk into the old town
d8-walk.note: Estimated arrival 9:45–10:15 AM. Špičák stop works well for castle-side sightseeing, if your bus uses it.

d8-castle.title: Castle courtyards and Vltava viewpoints
d8-castle.note: Enjoy castle courtyards, red rooftops and the S-shaped river bend. Tower and indoor museum are optional, not required.

d8-latran.title: Latrán Street and Lazebnický Bridge
d8-latran.note: Walk among historic buildings and take photos of the castle tower from the wooden bridge.

d8-lunch.title: Czech lunch with friends
d8-lunch.note: Find a cozy Czech restaurant or tavern for grilled dishes, stew or soup. No reservation yet.

d8-oldtown.title: Svornosti Square and medieval Old Town
d8-oldtown.note: Explore cobblestone lanes, St. Vitus Church surroundings and historic views.

d8-river.title: Vltava river walk and second photo stop
d8-river.note: Enjoy more riverside viewpoints before sunset. Fog may hide distant castle views.

d8-market.title: Český Krumlov Christmas market
d8-market.note: Browse the market and enjoy warm drinks and snacks. The friend's guide lists Thursday hours of 11 AM–6 PM; reconfirm locally.

d8-busback.title: Return bus to Prague with friends (unbooked)
d8-busback.note: Target bus around 5–6 PM, subject to real tickets. Hotel arrival is estimated around 8–9 PM.

d8-hotel.title: Return to Hotel Royal and pack for home
d8-hotel.note: Rest and prepare passports and SWISS tickets. Blacklane airport pickup is confirmed for 6:30 AM tomorrow.

d9-checkout.title: Check out of Hotel Royal
d9-checkout.note: Leave the hotel ready for early pickup.

d9-black.title: Blacklane Business Van to Prague Airport
d9-black.note: Confirmed pickup at 6:30 AM. Airport arrival around 7:02 AM is an estimate.

d9-airport.title: Arrive at Prague Airport and check in
d9-airport.note: Check bags and security at Terminal 2 for the Schengen flight.

d9-pp-prg.title: Priority Pass: Erste Premier Lounge at PRG
d9-pp-prg.note: Optional lounge in Terminal 2 airside on Level 3, open from 5 AM. Check guest rules.

d9-transfer.title: Transfer at Zurich Airport
d9-transfer.note: Allow time for passport control and your US-bound departure gate.

d9-pp-zrh.title: Priority Pass: Aspire Lounge at Zurich (E Gates only)
d9-pp-zrh.note: Only if LX38 uses E gates. Aspire is above Gate E52; skip if assigned to D gates or if the connection is tight.

d9-lx38.title: SWISS LX38: Zurich to SFO
d9-lx38.note: Depart 1:15 PM; arrive SFO at 4:30 PM Pacific time.

d9-uber.title: Uber Comfort pickup from SFO
d9-uber.note: Pickup is booked for 4:30 PM, the same as scheduled landing. Verify or adjust to allow for baggage and immigration.

2026-11-19.routeNote: Private ride to SFO at 6:35 PM. The public site never displays your home address.

2026-11-20.routeNote: Take S8 from MUC to Rosenheimer Platz. Follow the Gasteig / Muffatwerk exit and Holiday Inn signs through the Motorama indoor passage. Map lines only connect approximate locations; they do not trace the actual indoor route.

2026-11-21.title: Munich Old Town, Palace and Christmas market
2026-11-21.highlight: Confirmed 10:45 AM guided tour; Christmas music at 5:30 PM not confirmed
2026-11-21.routeNote: Stops are shown in the planned order. The walking tour guide decides where the tour ends.

2026-11-22.routeNote: Mentor Reisen's Nov 18 update: check in at Sonnenstraße 1 by about 8:40 AM. The tour MUST depart no later than 8:50 AM; 9:15 AM is no longer valid. Castle order and return time depend on the operator.
routeGroups: Holiday Inn to Mentor Reisen meeting point

2026-11-23.title: Train to Prague
2026-11-23.highlight: 5:40 AM Blacklane pickup and 6:44 AM EC353 train, tickets purchased

2026-11-24.highlight: Optional 8 PM classical concert; tickets not yet purchased

routeGroups: Prague Castle, Lesser Town and Petřín

2026-11-25.title: Prague Old Town and hotel change
2026-11-25.highlight: Collect luggage at The Grand Mark and move to Hotel Royal
2026-11-25.routeNote: Old Town sightseeing, pick up bags from Grand Mark, then move to Hotel Royal.

2026-11-26.title: Český Krumlov winter day trip with friends
2026-11-26.highlight: Meet friends at Hotel Royal for an early bus; castle, Old Town, river views and Christmas market. Bus tickets unbooked
2026-11-26.routeNote: Based on the friend's joint-trip guide. Bus times and stations are tentative, and four travelers must still have tickets. Airport pickup tomorrow is 6:30 AM.

2026-11-27.highlight: 6:30 AM Blacklane to PRG, then SWISS flights via ZRH to SFO
2026-11-27.routeNote: Blacklane to PRG, flights through Zurich to SFO. Home address is not published.
